summary: Outer lens fibres around the nucleus; optically clear with faint lamellar zones. Cortical cataract spokes form here.

scatter.note: Bulk backscatter of clear cortex. Render-calibrated.

refractive_index.note: Surface (cortical) index of the lens, Le Grand full theoretical eye (Atchison & Smith 2000, appendix). Used only for lens surface reflectance (Purkinje III/IV).

provenance.source: Render calibration; LOCS III: Chylack et al. (1993)
